question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

He has the _______ to express his thoughts.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"right"** refers to something that is morally good, justified, or acceptable. (सही)

 
 
• **Example:** Everyone has the** right **to express their opinions freely.
 
 
 
• **"right" **refers to having the freedom or authority to do something. (अधिकार)
 
 
• **Example:** He has the **right** to express his thoughts.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ride **(सवारी): To sit on and control the movement of an animal, typically a horse, or a vehicle.

 
 
• **Example:** I love to ride my bicycle through the park.
 
 
 
• **Write **(लिखना): To mark letters, words, or other symbols on a surface, typically paper, with a pen, pencil, or similar instrument.
 
 
• **Example:** She likes to write stories in her free time.
 
 
 
• **Rite **(अनुष्ठान): A religious or other solemn ceremony or act.
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding rite was performed with great devotion.
